title: Linda Brown sees a $100,000 check from the Townsend Brown Foundation to Stanford

tellings.quote: And Linda, who was visiting her father in Atherton at that time, remembers seeing a check from the Townsend Brown Foundation to Stanford for $100,000.

plain: Linda Brown, the daughter of Townsend Brown, a scientist Michels presents as having built UFO-like craft for the CIA, remembers seeing a check for $100,000 from the Townsend Brown Foundation to Stanford while visiting her father in Atherton, California, sometime in the 1970s. Michels tells this in his documentary on Brown, relaying what Linda told him, as a sign that Brown's work was being funded at Stanford's research institute.
